title: Mohnish Pabrai - The Value of Continuous Learning
summary:
What’s surprising is that while many people listen to
them, hardly anyone puts those lessons into practice. Today’s guest, Mohnish Pabrai, is not one to miss such
opportunities and he attributes much of his success to his hunger
to learn, improve, and adjust. Mohnish is an author and the Founder
and CEO of Pabrai Investment Fund, which he started in 1999 at the
peak of the tech bubble.

key_points.text: Mohnish is an author and the Founder and CEO of Pabrai Investment Fund.
In 1983 he moved to the United States from India, to study computer engineering at South Carolina's Clemson University.
After working in research and development, Mohnish launched his own successful IT consulting firm, TransTech, in 1991.
